issue.title: Sync Data [ import only]
issue.body:
- initial import based on the userid
- incremental sync on button click
- When the user changes relevant data (Projects, chapter assignments,bible-books, bible texts), they should be imported.
- While importing the above(i.e, the 3rd point), make sure no duplicate data is there.
- When the user is switched, make sure the data related to that user is visible
